description: This file defines function prototypes and structure references related to alias management in a command-line interface. It declares functions for alias lookup, quoting command lines, splitting command lines into arguments, handling errors from splitting, and listing aliases.

methods.name: alias_lookup
methods.description: Retrieves the command or value associated with a given alias.

methods.name: quote_cmdline
methods.description: Quotes command-line arguments to ensure they can be correctly parsed by split_cmdline.

methods.name: split_cmdline
methods.description: Splits a command line string into arguments, returning the argument list.

methods.name: split_cmdline_strerror
methods.description: Provides an error message corresponding to a negative value returned by split_cmdline.

methods.name: list_aliases
methods.description: Populates a string_list with all available aliases.
